title: Ofenkäse – Pizzaiolo Edition
creator: chrispy.pizza
steps: Knead all the dough ingredients into a smooth dough and let it rest, covered, for 30 minutes.
Divide into balls of about 285 g, shape them tight and leave to mature in the fridge. Take them out about 4 hours before baking.
Open a dough ball, pushing the air into the rim, and set a whole Camembert in the middle with a few spices and a splash of oil.
Bake at 350 °C top and bottom heat for 4–5 minutes in a pizza oven.
Finish with a spoonful of cranberry sauce and eat straight away.
notes: Baked in an electric pizza oven. The bottom heat cooks the slightly thicker base under the cheese.
